title.narrative: Emergency response to the climate and humanitarian crisis in Kenya
Risposta all’emergenza climatica e umanitaria in Kenya

description.narrative: L’iniziativa intende rispondere all’emergenza climatica e ai bisogni umanitari delle comunità locali e dei gruppi vulnerabili in Kenya mediante progetti realizzati dalle Organizzazioni della Società Civile (OSC) nei settori dell’Acqua, igiene, ambiente, territorio, gestione risorse naturali, cambiamenti climatici, Agricoltura e sicurezza alimentare, Parità di genere e Riduzione del rischio di catastrofi, al fine di fornire aiuto umanitario e rafforzare la resilienza della popolazione per mitigare gli effetti legati ad eventi climatici catastrofici.

The Programme aims at responding to the climate emergency and humanitarian needs of local communities and vulnerable groups in Kenya – through NGOs/CBOs implemented projects in the WaSH, natural resource management, climate change, agriculture and food security, gender equality and disaster risk reduction – to provide humanitarian assistance and mitigate the effects of catastrophic climate events.

tag.narrative: By 2030, achieve universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water for all

By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

By 2030, ensure that all men and women, in particular the poor and the vulnerable, have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land and other forms of property, inheritance, natural resources, appropriate new technology and financial services, including microfinance
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
